verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide has a first-party section on event notifications and subscriptions, so the product does offer its own event-subscription capability. The evidence is a single section title, though, and never says that delivery happens through registrable outbound HTTP webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook (HTTP callback) delivery, a subscription registration/API workflow, the supported event types, validation and renewal details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
